# Division 293 tax on concessional contributions by high-income earners
## Releasing money from super for a Division 293 tax liability
You have up to 60 days from the date of your Division 293 assessment to make your election.

Even if you are electing to release money from super, your liability should still be paid by the due date on your notice of assessment.

web.title: Responding to release authorities issued to SMSFs
web.description:
# Responding to release authorities issued to SMSFs
## Types of release authorities
- [Division 293 tax – due and payable](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/super-for-individuals-and-families/self-managed-super-funds-smsf/smsf-contributions-and-rollovers/responding-to-release-authorities-issued-to-smsfs#Division293taxdueandpayablereleaseauthor)

### Division 293 tax – due and payable
When an individual has a Division 293 tax due and payable debt associated with contributions made to accumulation super accounts, the debt must be paid within 21 days of the date of the notice of assessment.

The individual can elect to release an amount from their fund within 60 days of the issue date to pay the debt. We will issue a release authority to their nominated fund.
